deflation: phi_tilde = phi - Q (Q^T W phi) with Q from W-inner-product modified Gram-Schmidt on the stored raw outputs; the same coefficients are applied to the stored second derivatives, so the coefficients are constants with respect to the spatial derivative exactly as in arm (b)
drop_rule: a direction is dropped when its norm after orthogonalization falls below sqrt(eps_machine) times its norm before it
